name: After recital B
title: REPORT on general guidelines for the preparation of the 2026 budget, Section III – Commission
part_text: B. whereas, according to the working document ‘The Redistributive Function of the EU Budget’1a, the EU budget currently has a limited redistributive impact, and rebates and other compensation mechanisms affecting the contributions of some Member States further reduce the redistributive impact of the EU budget; 1a Pasimeni, P., & Riso, S. (2016). The Redistributive Function of the EU Budget (IMK Working Paper No. 174). Hans‑Böckler‑Stiftung. Available at http://www.boeckler.de/imk\_5016.htm
